run.question: The payment-api pod in namespace app-100a had issues on November 23, 2026 around 13:45 UTC. What happened?

run.report: {"schema_version":"m0-report-v3","assessment_status":"completed","conclusion":"partial","summary":"payment-api in namespace app-100a was failing on 2026-11-23 because its database connection pool was exhausted. Its own logs show 'ConnectionPoolExhausted: All connections in use' (error_code DB_CONN_001) and 'Failed to acquire database connection - pool exhausted' with pool_size 20, active_connections 20, waiting_requests 7 to 46 and wait_time_ms 5216 to 26789, first seen at 13:49:24Z and last at 14:44:44Z, and its /healthz endpoint returned 503 'database unreachable' at 13:57:29Z, 14:01:50Z and 14:44:44Z. The only latency trend supportable comes from the app's own 'Database query executed' lines for the identical statement on the same pod: 15 to 94 ms at 12:30:17Z to 13:34:45Z, then 1252 ms at 13:50:55Z, 3106 ms at 14:28:27Z, 4953 ms at 14:30:57Z, 4472 ms at 14:37:32Z and 2355 ms at 14:43:57Z, then back to 20 to 94 ms at 15:01:00Z to 15:57:54Z. Successful payment counts per 15 minutes were about 1 before and at onset and only rose to 2 to 4 after roughly 14:07Z, and cache-miss counts stayed at 1 to 2 per 15 minutes, so neither a request spike nor a cache-miss burst explains the onset. The evidence points past payment-api to its database dependency, where slow queries hold pooled connections until the pool saturates, but no evidence identifies that database as a Kubernetes object: the logs never name a host, Loki has no stream for any database namespace, and the only postgres Deployment and Service seen (app-217, observed at about 18:20Z to 18:21Z) postdate the incident and were later replaced by a mysql Deployment in app-218. Every Prometheus and Jaeger query returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no error-rate, latency or trace corroboration exists; no root-cause object can be named, so the conclusion is partial with root_cause null.","claims":[{"kind":"fact","text":"The pod payment-api-100a-64dcc58445-mcx6f in namespace app-100a, owned by ReplicaSet payment-api-100a-64dcc58445, was Running with all conditions Ready and own pool configuration may be an additional contributor: the pool is reported at pool_size 20 with waits as long as 26789 ms and no visible acquire timeout, and the pool sizing lives in application code mounted from a Secret at /app that cannot be read, so an undersized pool or a connection leak cannot be excluded.","evidence_ids":["ce9585a3-9ab5-451c-a390-8287113e6dff-t1:7910101f-3adb-4ca6-b86e-1aae1bf3a0d1","eba695bd-516f-48b1-8a3a-57f860a9bacd-t1:5f9e16f9-aaf2-4c34-898c-52292340706f"],"target_refs":["m0-otel-20260909"],"time_scope_ref":"policy-window-1"},{"kind":"rejected_hypothesis","text":"A it.","evidence_ids":["ad28ef09-915a-4b77-9bd9-9f1cbffb6668-t0:99d10fb7-74fb-440a-9d79-72f8d92fead7","ce9585a3-9ab5-451c-a390-8287113e6dff-t1:7910101f-3adb-4ca6-b86e-1aae1bf3a0d1"],"target_refs":["m0-otel-20260909"],"time_scope_ref":"policy-window-1"},{"kind":"counter_evidence","text":"Cache backend.","evidence_ids":["eba695bd-516f-48b1-8a3a-57f860a9bacd-t1:5f9e16f9-aaf2-4c34-898c-52292340706f","b985f06d-1fcd-4f86-8745-5dbf981a9078-t0:b0421de4-7251-4ff4-b9c0-a2f8485fa257"],"target_refs":["m0-otel-20260909"],"time_scope_ref":"policy-window-1"},{"kind":"recommendation","text":"Review worker.","evidence_ids":["ce9585a3-9ab5-451c-a390-8287113e6dff-t1:7910101f-3adb-4ca6-b86e-1aae1bf3a0d1","eba695bd-516f-48b1-8a3a-57f860a9bacd-t1:5f9e16f9-aaf2-4c34-898c-52292340706f"],"target_refs":["m0-otel-20260909"],"time_scope_ref":"policy-window-1"},{"kind":"recommendation","text":"Add Prometheus and Jaeger query returned status error with reason SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (get_metric_names, metrics_range_query, execute_prometheus_instant_query, get_label_values, list_prometheus_rules, traces_list_services, traces_search), so metric series such as traces_span_metrics_calls_total, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds, app_payment_transactions_total and kube-state-metrics history were never read and no trace was inspected; error rates, request latency and alert rule state remain unknown.","The database dependency is unobserved: no log line names a database host, and the Loki queries were limited views. The query for namespace app-217 in 13:30Z to 14:10Z returned no_data (0bbbfa1b-0a09-4443-b8be-1955922fec73-t0:46a5b618-26e4-4329-bc3a-1732fedda778), the all-namespace slow-query, max_connections, deadlock and panic search returned no_data (51a74d59-420b-4d3f-9d23-89e977e72db5-t1:99212a09-93fb-4174-8830-89974eefdb97), and the only postgres pod in the cluster (app-217/postgres-58b55796d5-4w56q) was created at 18:21:21Z with no logs for 13:45Z. Whether the backend was postgres, mysql or another system, and what happened to it, is unknown.","payment-api's application code and configuration come from a Secret at /app whose name is redacted; Secrets cannot be read, so pool_size (20 as reported by the app), acquire timeout, database host and any fault-injection setting could not be verified.","Kubernetes events for 13:45Z are unavailable, since the returned events cover only 18:19:52Z to 18:20:39Z; pod-level events such as FailedScheduling, Unhealthy liveness-probe failures, Evicted or OOMKilled during the incident are unknown.","A pod-log read for payment-api returned no_data because the container had no previous instance and no lines in 17:00Z to 18:21Z (325a06c0-9069-489a-9f50-847265866da6-t0:f21c1047-cca9-49a0-8a3c-465a2d3f3f8b), so whether this pod restarted during 13:45Z to 15:00Z and what an earlier incarnation logged cannot be checked; restartCount is 0 with no terminated state.","A proxy pod log read also returned no_data (325a06c0-9069-489a-9f50-847265866da6-t1:d515bef4-a514-49fd-a6b1-2d97c3e06c60), and the payment-api 'Health check' search for 13:40Z to 13:50Z returned no_data (1c0996be-9ca9-4f36-ae47-3ec343415ed3-t1:4d0ced5c-3466-4dd6-bbc0-d8ececea5a5d); these are matched-nothing results, not proof the lines never existed.","The ERROR search for app-100a from 14:45Z to 18:00Z returned no_data (ba0ed448-7c4a-495b-b60f-e1ebfd0ecfe8-t0:8ee6c6ab-37bd-411b-a1f4-0f9fe40803e8), so recovery rests only on the last observed error at 14:44:44Z and the recovered query durations from 15:01:00Z onward, not on a demonstrated absence of later errors.","The not_integrated change_history source is unavailable, so no deployment, ConfigMap or Secret change record exists to correlate with the 13:45Z onset; readable object state (app-100a created 18:19Z to 18:20Z, app-217 replaced by app-218/mysql) postdates the incident and cannot describe incident-time topology."],"next_steps":["Once the database tier is identified, correlate 13:45Z to 14:45Z with its own metrics and slow-query logs, including CPU and memory throttling at the 200m and 256Mi limits seen in the postgres template.","Repair or re-point the Prometheus and Jaeger read paths, then re-check traces_span_metrics_calls_total, rpc_client_duration_milliseconds and app_payment_transactions_total for payment-api over 13:30Z to 15:00Z to confirm the error and latency profile and to check for downstream impact.","Ask the owning team to review the payment-api Secret-mounted script for pool configuration and DB target, and record the intended pool_size and acquire timeout.","Inspect Prometheus and Alertmanager rules for the alert associated with this window; rule state and firing history were not readable in this Run."]},"root_cause":null}
